valor: Seyo Kim, una fiscal alemana de origen coreano, sobrevive a un ataque racista con una bomba molotov e inicia una investigación. El tortuoso proceso personal y legal pone en riesgo su integridad física, su trabajo y sus límites éticos. Un thriller judicial que denuncia la xenofobia en Alemania y un sistema policial y judicial lejos de ser imparcial.

valor: Seyo Kim, a German prosecutor of Korean origin, survives a racist Molotov cocktail attack and opens an investigation. The tortuous personal and legal process puts her physical safety, job, and ethical limits at risk. A legal thriller denouncing xenophobia in Germany and a police and judicial system far from impartial.

antes.ficci-65: Faraz Shariat constructs a political thriller in Germany about a young Iranian lawyer who defends asylum seekers while confronting his own identity and the contradictions of the European legal system.
